comparable_cases.why_comparable: Same address (3224 22nd St), same NCT-MISSION zoning. Agency referral for continuation of a Limited Restaurant (dba Breakfast Little), approved December 2018. Most recent health referral at this exact site before the current concept.
comparable_cases.key_takeaway: Planning approved continuation of the Limited Restaurant use as principally permitted per Planning Code Section 754, confirming the site's established limited-restaurant status without requiring a conditional use hearing.

comparable_cases.why_comparable: Same address (3224 22nd St), same NCT-MISSION zoning. Agency referral for continuation of a Limited Restaurant (dba Pushcart Fare), approved October 2018. Shows pattern of approved limited-restaurant continuations at this site.
comparable_cases.key_takeaway: Planning approved the continued use of a limited restaurant per BPA# 2012.10.3080 without requiring a conditional use hearing, treating it as an established permitted use.

comparable_cases.why_comparable: Same address (3224 22nd St), same NCT-MISSION zoning. ABC Type 41 referral approved April 2017. Shows Planning's position on alcohol service at this site as accessory to a full-service restaurant.
comparable_cases.key_takeaway: Planning recommended approval of a Type 41 beer-and-wine license in conjunction with an existing legal full-service restaurant (person-to-person transfer, not a new license), indicating the site was already operating as a full restaurant by 2017, not merely a limited restaurant.

comparable_cases.why_comparable: 2512 Mission St (138m away), same NCT-MISSION zoning and inside the Mission Alcohol SUD. ABC Type 41 referral approved November 2020 to establish a new Restaurant and Nighttime Entertainment use (dba Arcana).
comparable_cases.key_takeaway: Planning approved a new restaurant with beer-and-wine service and entertainment in the Mission Alcohol SUD via agency referral (per BPA#202011048158), showing that restaurants without hard liquor can be approved through the building permit process rather than a conditional use hearing even inside the SUD.

comparable_cases.why_comparable: 2512 Mission St (138m away), same NCT-MISSION zoning and inside the Mission Alcohol SUD. DPH referral approved May 2021 for a Restaurant use per BPA#202011048158 (same project as 2020-009285MIS).
comparable_cases.key_takeaway: Planning approved the full Restaurant use (not Limited Restaurant) via health referral in NCT-MISSION within the Mission Alcohol SUD, confirming that the building permit application (BPA) established the restaurant entitlement without a separate conditional use authorization.

comparable_cases.why_comparable: 3242 22nd St (same block, 0m away), same NCT-MISSION zoning. DPH referral for Limited Restaurant approved October 2020, showing continuation of limited restaurant uses on this block within the Mission Alcohol SUD.
comparable_cases.key_takeaway: Planning approved a Limited Restaurant via health referral on the same block in October 2020 without requiring a conditional use hearing, consistent with treating limited restaurants as principally permitted uses.

comparable_cases.why_comparable: 3242 22nd St (same block, 0m away), same NCT-MISSION zoning. Health referral for Limited Restaurant approved June 2019, further establishing the pattern of approved limited-restaurant continuations on this immediate block.
comparable_cases.key_takeaway: Planning approved another Limited Restaurant health referral on the same block in mid-2019 via agency referral in 8 days, demonstrating fast administrative approval for limited-restaurant continuations in NCT-MISSION.

comparable_cases.why_comparable: 3230 22nd St (same block, 0m away), same NCT-MISSION zoning. Health referral for Limited Restaurant approved June 2019, showing consistent treatment of limited restaurants as permitted uses on this specific block.
comparable_cases.key_takeaway: Planning approved a Limited Restaurant health referral for 3230 22nd St (immediately adjacent) in 15 days via agency referral, confirming that limited restaurants on this block are processed administratively without conditional use hearings.

comparable_cases.why_comparable: 3273 22nd St (77m away), NCT-VALENCIA zoning (adjacent district). DPH referral for Limited Restaurant approved June 2021 in 7 days, showing similarly fast administrative review for limited restaurants just outside the Mission Alcohol SUD.
comparable_cases.key_takeaway: Planning approved a Limited Restaurant via health referral in NCT-VALENCIA (the adjacent commercial district) in just 7 days, showing that limited-restaurant approvals are routine agency referrals across Mission-area neighborhood commercial districts.

filing_playbook.action: Request a written Letter of Determination from San Francisco Planning to confirm the CUA pathway and whether the 2008 CUA can be amended or a new one is required.
filing_playbook.what_to_say: Submit a letter to the Planning Department zoning counter describing the 404 sq ft full-service restaurant concept with commercial kitchen, no alcohol, operating before midnight. Reference the 2008 CUA (case 2008.0360C) at this address and ask: (1) Does the intensification from Limited Restaurant to full Restaurant require a new Conditional Use Authorization, or can it proceed under Planning Code §303(e) as an amendment? (2) What is the current count of eating and drinking uses in NCT-MISSION against the cap of 167? (3) If a new CUA is required, what is the approximate timeline and fee? Request a written answer before filing any applications or signing the lease.

filing_playbook.action: File for a San Francisco Business Registration Certificate with the Office of the Treasurer & Tax Collector immediately after forming the legal entity.
filing_playbook.what_to_say: Register with the EIN and legal entity name; pay the tiered fee ($55 up to $100k gross receipts, $95 up to $250k, plus $4 state fee). Every other city department asks for the Business Account Number (BAN), so obtain this.
filing_playbook.verification_note: Cut down to the part the cited record states.

filing_playbook.action: Apply for the Health Permit to Operate at least one month before the planned opening, after DPH plan check is approved.
filing_playbook.what_to_say: Submit the application online with the BAN, Location ID (LIN), and federal tax ID. Confirm that at least one owner or employee has completed a Certified Food Protection Manager course (ServSafe or equivalent, $100-$250, valid 5 years). The permit ($470 application fee, $0 annual license fee for 2026-28) is issued after the final inspection passes.

filing_playbook.action: Obtain ASCAP and BMI public performance licenses before opening if the restaurant plays recorded music (background music, streaming services).
filing_playbook.what_to_say: Federal copyright law requires a blanket license to play music publicly. Sign up online with ASCAP and BMI (each $300-$2,500 per year, formula-based on occupancy and music use). The licenses are effective immediately and take under a week to set up.

timeline_cost.notes: The timeline is 120-300 days and the cost is $5,500-$21,000 for the entitlement path (Conditional Use Authorization, Health permit to operate, Building permit with change of use) when those approvals are granted. The range covers: CUA application and hearing (120-180 days, $3,100 fee), building permit review and issuance (14-120 days, $800-$15,000 depending on construction valuation), DPH plan check (21-60 days, $828-$2,207), and health permit to operate (14-45 days, $470 application fee). The timeline runs from CUA filing to final health permit issuance; it does not include time spent before filing (pre-application meetings, architect's design, or the Letter of Determination request). If Planning determines a new CUA is not required and the concept can proceed as an administrative change of use, the timeline and cost would drop to approximately 60-150 days and $2,500-$8,000 (building permit, DPH plan check, and health permit only). The cost does not include state business formation, architect and engineering fees, construction costs, grease interceptor installation, or insurance. Add 30-60 days to the timeline for pre-application community meetings and plan preparation before the CUA filing. The CUA is the critical path: 6-10 months including environmental review, neighborhood notification, and Planning Commission hearing scheduling. File the CUA application before or in parallel with lease negotiations, with a lease contingency clause.

records_summary: 3224 22nd St sits in the NCT-MISSION zoning district where a Restaurant on the first story is a conditional use. The address lies inside the Mission Alcoholic Beverage Special Use District, which requires Conditional Use Authorization for any proposed Restaurant in the sub-area east of the western boundary and north of Cesar Chavez (regardless of alcohol service). The site has operated as a Limited Restaurant since at least 2001, with multiple health referrals approved for continuation of limited restaurant uses (dba Breakfast Little, Pushcart Fare, Futo) between 2016-2020. The immediate block is heavily saturated: 15 food/drink businesses and 12 active ABC on-sale licenses within 500 ft, with two bars (Make Out Room, Latin American Club) nearby.
